exact_statement: For a real Fourier quartet (alpha,beta,gamma,delta), both nonnegative merging refunds vanish iff Delta=alpha delta-beta gamma is zero or alpha gamma=beta delta and alpha beta=gamma delta. If Delta!=0, the latter case is exactly an opposite-diagonal support or delta=s alpha,gamma=s beta with s=+/-1, all four nonzero and alpha^2!=beta^2; the full-support exceptional physical row is supported on one parity class and has normalized collision>=1. For any Boolean F on n>=3 with spectral support distance>=3 and its one-point edit G, p=2^-n, C_i(G)<=8p,C_ij(G)<=16p and each pair total refund M_i+M_j<=16p. V_ij<=h2(3p)+3p log2(3)+16p/ln2<(3n+29)p and V_i<=h2(2p)+8p/ln2<(2n+13)p. A least-essential-dimension K-violation of this form must satisfy D_K(G)+S_ij+K(I_ij(F)-4p)<(3n+29)p, and D_K(G)+S_i+K(Inf_i(F)-2p)<(2n+13)p, where S are actual nonnegative physical child reserves. For every fixed nonconstant h, tensor t copies then substitute fresh triple parities and edit one point; t>=2 yields prime/full-support/all-essential Boolean G_t with connected cross-copy plaquette graph, total pair refunds<=16 binom(n,2)2^-n tending to0, and H(G_t)/I(G_t)->H(h)/(3I(h)). An absolute FEI bound for the union of these families implies unrestricted FEI up to factor3. The families are not admitted as minimal witnesses and do not disprove FEI.
